name: ballpoint
description: A cheap blue pen running dry: thin pressure-varied line, the skip where the ball stalled, a blob where it stopped.

prompt.default: ballpoint pen drawing: thin blue-black line that thins and thickens with pressure, occasional ink blob where the pen stopped, dry skips along the length
prompt.flux: a ballpoint pen drawing in blue-black ink, the line thinning and thickening under hand pressure, an ink blob where the pen rested, dry skips where the ball stalled, cheap notebook paper
prompt.sdxl: ballpoint pen, blue-black ink line, pressure variation, ink blob, sketch on paper
